input.summary: Cap set at twelve (12) months of fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap is tied to defined "Fees" (the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) under the first Order Form only, so it is illusory; we set it at the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, per our fallback position. Indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct remain uncapped as Excluded Claims.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
